notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
You control at least five untapped creatures, one of which must be black.
description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by tapping five creatures you control, one of which must be black.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
When the Rat enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
